label: A holder of another that is not MOTION_3 held in the act by which it holds cannot be lacking
paraphrase: Conclusion, relative first holder in the holding sense: it is impossible that there be no f, x and r with f distinct from x, f presently actualizing x in r, and f not MOTION_3 held in r. Such an f may be held in other respects, and may sustain its own act in r (a persistence power), so it is neither all-respect unheld nor pure act (Control part 6).
